title: Heat pumps have so far withstood the death of federal tax credits
summary: Canary Media (October 2026) reports heat pump shipments held up in 2026 despite the end of the 25C tax credit.

assertions.quote: The 25C tax credit for heat pumps, which shaved up to $2,000 off the price tag, expired at the end of 2025
It could be that the tax credit was never a determining factor for most people getting heat pumps

verdicts.note: Shipments held up after 25C ended and adoption tracks climate and prices, but the counterfactual is not measured.

assertions.quote: heat pumps — which can both cool and warm homes and wean buildings off polluting gas furnaces
